verdict.rationale: Treasury Prime documents a programmatic account-opening flow with distinct Person/Business/Account Application steps and an 'Incremental KYC' mode that can run KYC independent of account opening, showing some application-state modeling. However, KYC/KYB itself is explicitly delegated to a third-party vendor ('Integrate your preferred, bank-approved third-party KYC/KYB vendor into the account opening process') rather than Treasury Prime providing native document collection or watchlist screening APIs. Missing for 10: documented endpoints/objects for document upload, watchlist/sanctions screening results, and explicit application status/state enumerations.
